# O’Reilly Media - Technology and Business Training

> O’Reilly, the premier learning platform for technology professionals, offers the industry’s most extensive catalog of high-quality technical and professional skills development courses. From AI, programming, and cloud technologies to essential business skills such as leadership training and critical thinking, O’Reilly delivers highly trusted content from its network of renowned experts that meets a diverse array of learning needs, with more than 59,000 books, over 5,000 role-based on-demand courses, nearly 200 live events each month, access to interactive sandboxes and labs, and more. 

## Enterprise Solutions
- [For Enterprise](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/teams.html): Tailored solutions for organizations to enhance team skills and drive business success.
- [For Government](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/government.html): Specialized training resources designed for government agencies to improve workforce capabilities.
- [For Higher Ed](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/academic.html): Educational resources aimed at institutions of higher learning to support student and faculty development.
- [For Individuals](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/individuals.html): Learning opportunities for individuals seeking to enhance their skills and knowledge.

## Content Marketing and Sponsorship
- [Content Marketing Solutions](https://www.oreilly.com/content-marketing-solutions.html): Lead generation and thought leadership programs for technology companies seeking to reach O’Reilly's 2.8 million users worldwide.
- [Sponsored Content](https://www.oreilly.com/content-marketing/available-products.html): Gate an O’Reilly book, report, or early release title for lead gen campaigns.
